shots.text: We came home to Solenne for one night. Three lands were free. We thought the worst was over.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Solenne at dusk, the Sunstone glowing over a city packed with refugees. Lanterns everywhere. Quiet.

shots.text: At midnight, the east gate opened from the inside. Our own soldiers opened it. Their eyes were grey and empty.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The great east gate swinging open. Soldiers in Lanternguard blue standing aside... their eyes empty and grey.

shots.text: Cassivane had been emptying our soldiers for months, the way the Heralds were emptied, and keeping them in the barracks under our own colours. Two thousand of them.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Hollowed soldiers fighting in the streets; refugees running; Lanternguard fighting their own.

shots.text: Fennick held the gatehouse with half-built towers and a hammer.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Old Fennick in the gatehouse, spectacles on, firing half-built towers that crackle with unstable elements.

shots.text: Don't stand there, Spirewright! Get to the palace and get the Queen out. I've got the gate.
shots.speaker: fennick
shots.art_note: Fennick shouting over his shoulder, then turning back to the gate as it starts to fall.

shots.text: The gatehouse came down on him. He held the gate until it did.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The gatehouse collapsing in a cloud of dust and coloured sparks. Silence.

shots.text: Cassivane climbed the Spire of Aurel to the Sunstone. Its light burned the things of the dark, and he had become one of them. He broke it.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane at the top of the Spire, his red armour blackening, smashing the huge lens. Its pieces fall across the city like burning stars.

shots.text: Then he came down for the Heartstone, the key to the Black Gate. Six years ago he had chipped a sliver off it, and that sliver opened the Gate. Now he wanted the rest.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane striding into the Hall of the Ring, a six-coloured crystal sliver glowing in his fist.

shots.text: I got there first. I took the Heartstone and ran. The pieces of the Sunstone were falling all around me, and their light was the last thing I ever saw.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde running from the hall with the Heartstone in her arms, looking up as the falling light hits her face; white-out.

shots.text: Give me the stone, Ysolde! He has my daughter. He gives her back when the Gate is open!
shots.speaker: cassivane
shots.art_note: Cassivane in the smoke of the courtyard, hand out, grey creeping into his eyes. Tamsin dragging the blind Queen into cover, the Heartstone clutched between them.

shots.text: Tamsin got me out. Cassivane gathered up the pieces of the Sunstone and fled east. One piece he never found. It had fallen all the way to the Rift.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane leaving through the broken gate with the glowing shards in a net. Far to the east, one small white shard falling into the Rift.

shots.text:
With the Sunstone broken, nothing held the dark down in the Rift any more. Before morning it came up and spread across the sky. The sun did not rise.

That was the start of the Long Night.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A wall of darkness rising out of the eastern horizon and rolling over the sky. Dawn hour: a black sky over Solenne. Only torches. Refugees looking up.
